prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Scaling the parent's fan-out damping by using a stronger exponent (w=1/(1+log1p(k)) applied as an extra multiplicative factor on top of the existing 1/log1p(k+1)) pushes hub/clock nets further out of the gradient so the cut term concentrates on genuine signal nets, reducing crit_cross and TNS on all circuits without touching the balance term (which the history shows is fragile).
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-0.135 robust(mean-std)=-0.132 min_case=-0.160 seed_std=0.093 tns_mean=+0.008 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.052 dWNS=+6.8% dTNS=+4.2% per-seed=[+0.09 +0.04 +0.03]
  C2: score=-0.028 dWNS=-7.3% dTNS=+0.8% per-seed=[+0.03 -0.04 -0.07]
  C3: score=-0.160 dWNS=-29.9% dTNS=-2.7% per-seed=[-0.02 +0.01 -0.46]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->135, wcut 421->413, crit_cross 0.011->0.005, repair_flips 103->102, changed-vs-baseline 2.0%
  C2: cut 318->316, wcut 1007->994, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->237, changed-vs-baseline 3.3%
  C3: cut 582->574, wcut 1955->1923, crit_cross 0.069->0.047, repair_flips 353->343, changed-vs-baseline 10.2%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: Hypothesis partly held: crit_cross fell on C1 (0.011→0.005) and C3 (0.069→0.047), with cut/wcut and repair_flips down modestly, consistent with hub nets leaving the gradient. But C3's score collapsed (-0.160, dWNS -29.9%, one seed -0.46) and C2 regressed slightly; TNS barely moved (+0.008). Seed spread is unacceptable (std 0.093, C3 outlier). Next step: gate the extra damping to high-fanout nets only (or cap the exponent) and re-test C3 across more seeds to confirm the outlier is variance, not a real WNS regression.
